strategies.brief: Industry + business news sweep for NEWLY ANNOUNCED Iraq oil pipeline projects (roughly the last 3 years): "<country> new oil pipeline <year>", FID announcements, MOUs, FEED/EPC awards, tenders, capacity-expansion projects that include new pipe. Search in-country languages too.

Regulator / ministry / TSO paper trail for Iraq: national energy regulator filings and project inventories, environmental-permit applications, ministry project lists, TSO ten-year development plans (or the national equivalent - FERC-style dockets where they exist).
Operator/sponsor project pages: identify the main midstream, TSO, and NOC players operating in Iraq and crawl their project/infrastructure pages and annual reports for oil pipeline projects.

The MISSING-pipeline stance: Iraq national oil grid maps, TSO network maps, oil/energy master plans, IEA/EIA and national-statistics infrastructure inventories - OPERATING or under-construction transmission lines that GEM never captured (not just new announcements). A line on the national grid map with no roster match is exactly what this strategy exists to find.

Cross-border lines touching Iraq in either direction: interconnectors, import/export lines, transit corridors. Check the neighbouring countries' TSO/ministry project lists for lines that terminate in Iraq.

Known 2026 leads to run down (verify independently; press URLs checked 2026-07-17 but you must still url_verifier them and corroborate): (1) Chevron-led consortium evaluating Mediterranean export corridors (kpler.com/blog/new-pipelines-bypassing-the-strait-of-hormuz-could-come-online-in-1-2-years): route options Basra-Haditha-Kirkuk-Ceyhan and Basra-Haditha-Baniyas; feasibility studies due end-2026. (2) Turkiye's March 2026 proposal to extend the Kirkuk-Ceyhan (Iraq-Turkiye) line south to Basra. CAREFUL match-to-existing: GEM already has Basra-Aqaba (P0544 Basra-Haditha construction / P5240 Haditha-Aqaba proposed), Kirkuk-Baniyas rehab rows (P7913 proposed, P5277-P5279 shelved), Iraq-Oman (P7960 proposed), and the ITP/Kirkuk-Ceyhan system - new corridor talk may be a status/scope change on those (notes/monitor), and only genuinely new segments (e.g. a new Haditha-Ceyhan connector) are new_row candidates.
